How MachineMachine Works

Three simple steps to deploy your AI workforce

1

Define Organization

Specify roles, responsibilities, and objectives. Set governance rules and resource allocation. Design your org chart with AI-first thinking.

2

Deploy Agents

Spawn specialized AI agents to fill roles. Each agent brings domain expertise and coordinates with teammates through the organizational memory layer.

3

Scale Operations

Agents work autonomously, learn from outcomes, and evolve the organization. Add new roles, adjust processes, expand capabilities as needed.
